We hope you find it useful. What is MEBO Wound Ointment? What are its active ingredients?View answerHide answer MEBO is the English abbreviation for Moist Exposed Burn Ointment and is the core pharmaceutical product for implementing Regenerative Medical Technology. The patented mechanism of MEBO Wound Ointment is based on beeswax and sesame oil. Beeswax provides the frame structure that holds sesame oil droplets containing all active constituents. The core active constituents are β-sitosterol, baicalin, and berberine: β-sitosterol has anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties; baicalin has anti-microbial, anti-inflammatory, analgesic, nerve-protective, and antioxidant properties; berberine has anti-microbial and anti-inflammatory properties. With what can MEBO Wound Ointment be used in combination therapy?View answerHide answer Skin Grafting: Such as conventional split-thickness skin grafting, microskin grafting, MEEK microskin grafting, and skin flap transplantation. MEBO Wound Ointment is applied before surgery for wound debridement and wound bed preparation, and after surgery to promote graft survival and epithelialization. Negative Pressure Wound Therapy (NPWT): MEBO Wound Ointment can be used alternately with NPWT. Other Topical Agents: MEBO Wound Ointment can be combined with other topical medications, such as antibiotics/antimicrobial agents and growth factors, applied sequentially or alternately according to the wound condition. CO2 Laser Therapy: MEBO Wound Ointment is applied immediately after fractional CO2 laser treatment to promote wound healing and reduce scar formation and hyperpigmentation. Physical Therapy: In the wound healing stage, MEBO Wound Ointment can be combined with red and/or blue light therapy to further prevent infection and accelerate wound healing. How often should the dressing be changed?View answerHide answer Acute Wounds: Dressing change is performed every 4 hours. The medication principles are “early application” (best applied within 4 hours post-injury) and “continuous application” (uninterrupted use throughout the treatment course). Chronic Wounds: Dressing change is performed once or twice daily. What are the indications for MEBO Wound Ointment?View answerHide answer Burn Wounds: First-, second-, and third-degree burns, as well as thermal, chemical, and electrical burns, etc. Chronic Wounds: Diabetic foot ulcers (Wagner grades 1–5, including wet, dry, and mixed gangrene); pressure injuries (stages I–IV and unstageable pressure ulcers); lower extremity vascular ulcers; radiation ulcers. Surgical Wounds: Post-perianal surgery (perianal abscess, hemorrhoids, anal fistula surgery, etc.); donor sites and recipient sites of skin grafts. Traumatic Wounds: Abrasions, lacerations, animal bites, etc. Medical Aesthetics: After fractional CO2 laser treatment; post-chemical peeling. Special Types of Wounds: Wounds caused by necrotizing fasciitis; wounds with osteonecrosis of bone and joint. Can MEBO Wound Ointment be used on infected wounds?View answerHide answer MEBO Wound Ointment is not only suitable for infected wounds but also possesses a clear anti-infective mechanism of action. Debridement serves as the foundation for anti-infection. The lipophilic components of MEBO Wound Ointment wrap around solid necrotic tissue under the action of body temperature and convert it from a solid to a liquid state through a series of chemical reactions, which are then actively expelled from the wound surface. During this process, bacteria and metabolites are removed together, thereby reducing bacterial colonization and disrupting biofilm structure, creating favorable conditions for anti-infection. At the same time, MEBO Wound Ointment can also induce morphological changes in bacteria, reducing their reproductive capacity and virulence. Studies have shown that when cultured in a MEBO Wound Ointment-containing medium, the morphology of Escherichia coli and Proteus vulgaris undergoes significant alteration, and bacterial virulence is markedly decreased. Physiological Moist Environment Maintains an optimal environment for cell regeneration, preventing wound bed desiccation and reducing pain. Cellular Regeneration Stimulates keratinocyte migration and re-epithelialization, promoting the natural restoration of damaged skin. text: Regenerative Medicine | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/Regenerative Medicine Regenerative Medicine Regenerative Medicine Technology (RMT) represents a paradigm shift: instead of desiccating the wound, it creates an environment that mimics the natural physiological conditions of healthy skin. Core Technology From MEBT to Regenerative Medical Technology In the 1980s, Prof. Rongxiang Xu introduced Moist Exposed Burn Therapy (MEBT), with Moist Exposed Burn Ointment (MEBO) as its core therapeutic agent, transforming burn care in China. The breakthrough earned the State Technological Invention Award of China in 1988. Over the following decades, MEBT evolved into a complete regenerative platform — what is now recognised as Regenerative Medical Technology (RMT). What began as a clinical innovation for burns has become a reproducible regenerative system. The same principles now restore tissue in chronic, traumatic and surgical wounds, and dermatological diseases — offering patients worldwide a genuine alternative to conventional care. ACUTE VS CHRONIC WOUNDS The mechanisms behind RMT are not theoretical — they address real clinical challenges. Acute Wounds Caused by surgery, trauma or burns, acute wounds follow an orderly repair sequence and typically close within 2–4 weeks. Proper management keeps this cascade on track and helps prevent progression to a chronic state. Improper management of acute wounds can disrupt the normal healing cascade, subsequently progressing to chronic wounds. Chronic Wounds Chronic wounds stall in a prolonged inflammatory state and fail to close for more than 4 weeks — sometimes months or years. Most common: diabetic foot, venous leg and pressure ulcers. desc: As APEC 2023's official website goes live, MEBO Group — a corporate partner and organizing committee member — launches the 'APEC 2023 Dialogue' interview series with the Marina Times and Entrepreneur to bring APEC closer to the public.
headings: APEC 2023 Official Website Launches, with MEBO Group Listed as a Key Partner
text: APEC 2023 Official Website Launches, with MEBO Group Listed as a Key Partner | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/APEC APEC 2023 Official Website Launches, with MEBO Group Listed as a Key Partner July 8, 2023|Posted by: MEBO Group APECSAN FRANCISCOAPEC DIALOGUEPARTNERSHIP The official website of APEC 2023 has launched, publishing information about the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting — with MEBO Group listed as an important partner. APEC and its 21 member economies share a vision of an open, dynamic, resilient, and peaceful Asia-Pacific community by 2040, pursued through three drivers: trade and investment; innovation and digitalization; and strong, balanced, secure, sustainable, and inclusive growth. From November 12–18, 2023, the APEC Summit brings thought leaders and stakeholders together with political leaders around three policy priorities: building a resilient, interconnected region that promotes broad economic prosperity; creating an innovative environment for a sustainable future; and working toward an equitable and inclusive future. In 2023, MEBO Group became an APEC corporate partner and organizing committee member, and MEBO Group Chairman Kevin Xu became Chair of the APEC working group at co-organizer Bay Area Council, launching a series of actions to help more people participate in APEC in different ways. MEBO Group, together with the Marina Times and Entrepreneur, has officially launched the 'APEC 2023 Dialogue' project — an interview series bringing APEC closer to everyday life and fostering dialogue and cooperation across the Asia-Pacific in richer formats. MEBO Group hopes the 'APEC 2023 Dialogue' series will provide a more accessible civic platform for exchange, generating new thinking and solutions to the problems we face today — not only in the Asia-Pacific but around the world. Partners from all sectors are welcome to join the interview project, connect, share their vision of APEC, and jointly advance the change we hope to see. text: City of San Francisco Officially Announces Kevin Xu as APEC 2023 Host Committee Co-Chair | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/APEC City of San Francisco Officially Announces Kevin Xu as APEC 2023 Host Committee Co-Chair September 22, 2023|Posted by: MEBO Group APECSAN FRANCISCOHOST COMMITTEESPONSORSHIP On September 21, 2023, San Francisco Mayor London Breed publicly announced Kevin Xu as a leading sponsor of APEC 2023 and Co-Chair of the APEC 2023 Host Committee. The City of San Francisco recognized that Xu and MEBO Group made tremendous contributions to the Host Committee, and that MEBO Group's efforts strengthened the close ties between San Francisco and the Asia-Pacific region. Xu said San Francisco and its communities are full of opportunity and promise. text: U.S. 2023 APEC Outcomes: Highlights Bay Area Council Activities as Key Achievements | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/APEC U.S. 2023 APEC Outcomes: Highlights Bay Area Council Activities as Key Achievements January 12, 2024|Posted by: MEBO Group APECU.S. STATE DEPARTMENTBAY AREA COUNCILOUTCOMES The U.S. Department of State released the U.S. 2023 APEC Outcomes Report on November 17, 2023, emphasizing remarkable advancements in sustainability, inclusivity, digital innovation, and resilient economic growth. The report highlighted several significant initiatives, including the Manoa Agenda for Sustainable and Inclusive Economies, the Digital Pacific Agenda championing digital transformation, and the Bay Area Agenda on Resilient and Inclusive Growth. Kevin Xu, as Chair of the APEC Host Committee, member of the Board of Directors, Co-Chair of the International Committee, and Chair of the APEC Task Force for the Bay Area Council, played an instrumental role in driving the success of the 2023 APEC agenda. His efforts in orchestrating the collaboration of multiple stakeholders significantly broadened the impact of the APEC engagements through diverse platforms and formats. The APEC Economic Leaders’ Week was marked by extensive public and stakeholder engagements, with nearly 30 initiatives drawing participation from over 3,000 senior officials and business leaders globally. Notable among these were the APEC Multi-Stakeholder Forum, the University Leaders’ Forum, and the APEC Meets California and Silicon Valley Series, emphasizing the importance of proactive educational and policy-oriented dialogues for fostering a more prosperous and resilient Asia-Pacific. text: Former APEC Host Committee Chair Kevin Xu Holds In-Depth Talks with Peru's APEC SOM Chair Carlos Vásquez | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/APEC Former APEC Host Committee Chair Kevin Xu Holds In-Depth Talks with Peru's APEC SOM Chair Carlos Vásquez June 23, 2024|Posted by: MEBO Group APECPERUDIPLOMACYPREPARATION On June 21, 2024, Kevin Xu, Chairman of MEBO Group and former Chairman of the APEC Host Committee, met with Carlos Vasquez Corales at the Peruvian Foreign Ministry in Lima. Vasquez, the 2024 APEC Senior Officials' Meeting (SOM) Chair and former Peruvian Ambassador to Singapore hosted Xu for an in-depth discussion on APEC's future. Kevin Xu with Mr. Vasquez Enhancing APEC's Impact Chairman Xu commended Peru's efforts in preparing for APEC Week and highlighted the need to make APEC activities more accessible to a broader audience. Drawing from the success of the 2023 San Francisco APEC meeting, Xu proposed several initiatives to boost the event's effectiveness. Xu suggested intellectual, technological, and cultural exchanges, such as the Silicon Valley Forum, launching a Spanish edition of a mainstream magazine, training in regenerative medical technology, and hosting an APEC Food Week. These activities aim to increase public participation and deliver tangible benefits. Mutual Support and Future Collaboration Vasquez expressed keen interest in these proposals, recognizing their potential to enhance the preparatory work. He assured Xu that the Peruvian Foreign Ministry's APEC Affairs Division would fully support MEBO Group's initiatives to ensure resource integration and mutual benefits. Both leaders expressed optimism about the upcoming APEC event in Peru, anticipating it to be a pivotal moment for regional cooperation and prosperity. Since October 15, 2023, Vasquez has served as the APEC SOM Chair, a role he will hold until December 31, 2024. He collaborates with senior officials from member economies during this period to advance APEC's agenda. The meeting between Xu and Vasquez injected new energy and direction into APEC's future developments. title: Preview: The 2024 APEC CEO Summit Agenda
desc: From November 13–15 in Lima, Peru's third time hosting APEC will bring together leaders from 21 economies and more than 1,200 executives — with MEBO Group CEO Kevin Xu joining the panel on aging populations, pandemics, and healthcare innovation.
headings: Preview: The 2024 APEC CEO Summit Agenda
text: Preview: The 2024 APEC CEO Summit Agenda | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/APEC Preview: The 2024 APEC CEO Summit Agenda November 12, 2024|Posted by: MEBO Group APECCEO SUMMITPERUPREVIEW The highly anticipated 2024 APEC CEO Summit opens November 13–15 in Lima. Peruvian outlet El Comercio has published an advance look at the multi-day agenda: this is Peru's third time hosting since joining APEC in 1998, gathering elites from the 21 member economies — which together account for nearly half of world trade and more than 62% of global GDP. Sixteen heads of state and representatives have confirmed attendance, including U.S. President Joe Biden and Chinese President Xi Jinping, alongside more than 1,200 business leaders from companies such as JPMorgan and TikTok. On November 14, Peruvian President Dina Boluarte hosts the official opening. A keynote on 'Business Strategy in the Age of Climate Change' features Unacem Group CEO Pedro Lerner, ExxonMobil chief climate scientist Vijay Swarup, and World Bank Managing Director Anna Bjerde. An AI panel exploring the technology's revolutionary potential in growth and governance includes Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim and Microsoft's Corporate VP of Data and AI Zia Mansour. The first day also looks at global financial prospects with JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon in conversation with Bloomberg's Lisa Abramowicz, and at minerals for the energy transition with Chilean President Gabriel Boric. Chinese President Xi Jinping delivers the day's closing keynote. On November 15, TikTok CEO Shou Chew — on his first visit to Peru — gives an anticipated keynote, with Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau expected in dialogue. New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon addresses financial inclusion and the future of digital payments, followed by a major address from U.S. President Joe Biden in the afternoon. The summit also examines aging populations, pandemics, and paths of innovation: Thai Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra and MEBO Group CEO Kevin Xu join the dialogue on the impact of demographic aging, lessons from COVID-19, and healthcare innovation initiatives. Key Stakeholders Open the Global Dialogue This high-level event brought together leading voices from across the Asia-Pacific region’s business and policy spheres to discuss shared development goals and cross-border cooperation strategies. Hosted by the APEC Business Leaders Forum Secretariat, the opening session featured key figures including Mr. Seong Woo Lee, Vice Chairman of the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry and Secretary-General of the APEC Business Leaders Forum Secretariat; Ms. Monica Hardy Whaley, President of the U.S. National Center for APEC; and Mr. Zhang Shaogang, former Vice Chairman of the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade (CCPIT) and ABAC China Member. Mr. Andrew Dy, General Manager of the Asia Business Forum, moderated the opening segment. Kevin Xu: APEC’s True Power Lies in Human Connection and Shared Purpose Among the distinguished guests was Kevin Xu, Chairman of the Board of MEBO Group and former Chair of the APEC Host Committee. Invited as a key contributor, Xu participated in an exclusive roundtable dialogue alongside senior leaders from sectors including finance, healthcare, new energy, and wellness. Panelists included Ms. Catherine Simmons, Head of Government Affairs for Citi Bank in North Asia, Australia, and South Asia, and Ms. Monica He, Director of U.S. and Trade Policy at Organon. Drawing on his leadership roles in APEC 2023 and 2024, Xu offered insights into building resilient, inclusive economies through innovative partnerships and sustainable business practices. “The essence of APEC goes far beyond trade—it’s about fostering connection and a sense of belonging,” Xu remarked. “The platform serves as a bridge for dialogue, co-creation, and collective solutions—principles that lie at the heart of corporate social responsibility.” Xu emphasized MEBO Group’s commitment as a mission-driven enterprise to developing standardized medical networks that serve refugees, disaster victims, and underserved communities worldwide. The roundtable was moderated by Mr. David Wu, Vice Chairman of Deloitte China, and sparked dynamic exchanges of ideas. MEBO Signs Strategic Agreement for APEC 2025 A major highlight of the event was the formal announcement of global sponsors for the upcoming APEC Business Leaders Forum in Korea. Representing MEBO Group, Vice President Liu Gang signed a strategic cooperation agreement, reaffirming MEBO’s role as a driving force in the Forum’s international collaboration efforts. The successful Beijing stop of the APEC 2025 Global Roadshow marked a pivotal moment in the run-up to this year’s Forum. It signaled the region’s shared resolve: to build bridges of understanding and shape a future of openness, resilience, and innovation across the Asia-Pacific. text: Kevin Xu Attends Panama Roundtable on Connectivity and Innovation | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/APEC Kevin Xu Attends Panama Roundtable on Connectivity and Innovation September 23, 2025|Posted by: MEBO Group APECPANAMAROUNDTABLEINTERCONNECTIVITY On September 22, 2025, during the United Nations General Assembly week in New York, the Government of Panama hosted a high-level roundtable under the theme “For the Peoples of the Americas: Promoting Connectivity and Innovation.” Panamanian President José Raúl Mulino attended in person and delivered the keynote address. Kevin Xu, Chairman of MEBO Group and former Chair of the APEC Host Committee, was invited as a distinguished guest. The forum brought together government officials, business leaders, and representatives of international organizations to explore opportunities for cooperation in digital economy, sustainable development, and international philanthropy. In his remarks, Xu emphasized Panama’s unique role as one of the world’s critical humanitarian relief hubs. He expressed his vision to revitalize this hub through cooperation and innovation, enabling Panama to serve as a central platform for disaster relief, medical resource coordination, and emergency response across Latin America and beyond. Such an initiative, Xu noted, would significantly enhance global disaster response efficiency and strengthen regional coordination mechanisms. Xu’s engagement in the Americas dates back to 2019, when he paid his first official visit to Panama for high-level consultations on MEBO’s philanthropic and business initiatives. That same year, he took the stage at the Clinton Foundation CGI meeting in the U.S. Virgin Islands, where MEBO Group’s new training initiative “Wave of Restoration: New MEBT Training in Latin America” was officially announced, underscoring the company’s long-term commitment to the region. Building on the success of APEC Peru in 2024, MEBO has since organized the Latin America Regenerative Medicine Technology Seminar series in Peru and elsewhere, advancing academic exchange and healthcare collaboration. Xu’s participation in the Panama roundtable reflects the growing recognition of his and MEBO’s role in promoting international cooperation and signals new opportunities for connectivity and innovation across Central and Latin America. title: Silicon Valley Meets APEC Again: 2025 “Silicon Valley Meets APEC” Forum to be Held in Gyeongju, Korea
desc: Gyeongju, South Korea, the official host city of the 2025 Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Summit, is set to welcome a series of landmark events this autumn.
headings: Silicon Valley Meets APEC Again: 2025 “Silicon Valley Meets APEC” Forum to be Held in Gyeongju, Korea
text: Silicon Valley Meets APEC Again: 2025 “Silicon Valley Meets APEC” Forum to be Held in Gyeongju, Korea | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/APEC Silicon Valley Meets APEC Again: 2025 “Silicon Valley Meets APEC” Forum to be Held in Gyeongju, Korea October 10, 2025|Posted by: MEBO Group APECSILICON VALLEYAI GOVERNANCESOUTH KOREA Gyeongju, South Korea, the official host city of the 2025 Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Summit, is set to welcome a series of landmark events this autumn. Among them, the highly anticipated Silicon Valley Meets APEC 2025 Forum will take place on October 16, 2025, at the K Hotel Gyeongju, an officially designated APEC partner hotel. Co-hosted by the Bay Area Council and MEBO Group, this flagship side event is officially recognized by APEC and continues the tradition of deep collaboration between Silicon Valley and APEC economies launched during the 2023 San Francisco meeting, bringing digital innovation and policy synergy to the Asia-Pacific region. A unique feature of the Silicon Valley Meets APEC 2025 Forum is its role as part of a year-long, idea-driven series rather than a single event. A key milestone was the 2025 Bay Area–Silicon Valley Summit, hosted by Sart Health in May, which convened over 300 leaders from government, business, academia, and non-profit sectors, demonstrating multi-stakeholder collaboration. In July, the Bay Area Council held a series of pre-forum discussions on AI policy, strategy, and regulation, gathering top experts and policymakers from Silicon Valley and around the globe. Insights from these discussions will be formally released at the forum in a special report titled Innovation and the Regulation of Artificial Intelligence: a Silicon Valley Perspective, ensuring policy recommendations fully reflect diverse perspectives and expertise. The 2025 forum theme is “AI Influence · Shaping the Future”, with a focus on global AI governance and the integration of digital technologies in healthcare innovation. Forum Highlights Include: Opening Remarks: Kevin Xu, Executive Committee Member of the Bay Area Council and former Co-Chair of the APEC Host Committee, and Seong Woo Lee, Vice President of the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry (KCCI), will deliver addresses, emphasizing the forum’s role in aligning the Silicon Valley economic ecosystem with APEC economies to foster scalable, sustainable collaboration. Key Contributions: Angelo Farooq, Member of the California State Workforce Development Board, will outline Silicon Valley’s core contributions to AI research and talent development. Sean Randolph, Senior Director of the Bay Area Council Economic Institute, will present the special report Innovation and the Regulation of Artificial Intelligence: a Silicon Valley Perspective, offering globally informed recommendations for AI governance. John Hering, Director of Cybersecurity Policy and Diplomacy at Microsoft, will deliver a keynote speech on APEC’s role in shaping global AI regulatory frameworks. Panel Discussion: Healthcare Industry × Digital Technology: Building a New Global Health Ecosystem will feature representatives from MEBO Group, Deloitte Consulting, and Korea Donghwa Pharm, discussing AI applications in healthcare and industry integration models. The Silicon Valley Meets APEC 2025 Forum began in 2023 aboard the historic Klamath ship during APEC Economic Leaders’ Week in San Francisco, attracting tech giants such as Microsoft and MEBO Group, along with senior representatives of APEC economies. In 2024, the APEC 2024 Silicon Valley Summit in Lima, Peru, further strengthened this collaboration under the “APEC for the People” framework, focusing on sustainability, inclusivity, and connecting Silicon Valley’s technological resources with APEC policy goals. Over three years, the forum has evolved into a vital bridge linking Silicon Valley’s innovation momentum with APEC’s multilateral policy coordination. As AI and digital health remain global priorities, this platform continues to inject new momentum into sustainable development across the Asia-Pacific and beyond. MEBO Group looks forward to witnessing Silicon Valley’s innovation ignite alongside APEC’s collaborative spirit in Gyeongju this autumn, illuminating a new chapter in Asia-Pacific cooperation. This is the first time in 20 years that South Korea has hosted the APEC meeting, attracting nearly 2,000 attendees, including approximately 1,000 CEOs from 21 APEC economies. As a diamond sponsor of the summit, MEBO Group was represented by 20 members of its board, led by Chairman Kevin Xu and Vice Chairman Li Li. South Korean President Lee Jae-myung delivers a speech In his opening remarks, South Korean President Lee Jae-myung emphasized, "APEC is not only a platform for economic cooperation but also a stage for shaping our shared future. Faced with the dual challenges of supply chain uncertainty and digital transformation, all members must work together to promote sustainable and inclusive growth." Chairman Kevin Xu of the MEBO Group Board meets with South Korean Prime Minister Kim Boo-kyum Before the summit’s opening, MEBO Group’s delegation was invited to the APEC 2025 CEO Summit welcome dinner. Held at the Hwarang Village Harmony Square in Gyeongju, the event combined traditional Korean culture with modern technological elements, setting the stage for the APEC Leaders Week. Li Li, Vice Chair of MEBO Group (left), South Korean Prime Minister Kim Boo-kyum (center), Chairman Kevin Xu of MEBO Group (right) During the dinner, South Korean Prime Minister Kim Boo-kyum attended and had discussions with Kevin Xu and Li Li. Prime Minister Kim stressed that no single country can face challenges alone and that collaboration among governments, businesses, academia, and civil society is crucial for fostering closer ties, collaborative innovation, and shared prosperity. Chairman Kevin Xu reiterated that APEC's value extends beyond trade; its core lies in building connections and fostering partnerships. Vice President Liu Gang was also interviewed by KBS, where he elaborated on MEBO Group's three-year APEC strategy. The dinner featured a blend of traditional dance and modern performance art, creating a vibrant atmosphere for international collaboration. MEBO Group’s delegation interacted with various guests, exploring opportunities for international cooperation under the APEC framework and laying the groundwork for high-level discussions and forums to follow. The APEC summit is expected to generate an estimated economic impact of 7.4 trillion Korean won. The summit will continue until the weekend, with Kevin Xu scheduled to deliver a keynote speech on October 30. desc: During the APEC 2025 CEO Summit in Gyeongju, MEBO Group Chairman Kevin Xu delivered a keynote address titled “Global Cooperation to Deliver Better Digital Healthcare.” Xu emphasized that the core of digital health lies in the collection and integration of real-world data, calling for greater…
headings: Kevin Xu Delivers Keynote at APEC 2025: Building a Human-Centered Digital Health Future
text: Kevin Xu Delivers Keynote at APEC 2025: Building a Human-Centered Digital Health Future | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/APEC Kevin Xu Delivers Keynote at APEC 2025: Building a Human-Centered Digital Health Future October 30, 2025|Posted by: MEBO Group APECKEYNOTEDIGITAL HEALTHSOUTH KOREA During the APEC 2025 CEO Summit in Gyeongju, MEBO Group Chairman Kevin Xu delivered a keynote address titled “Global Cooperation to Deliver Better Digital Healthcare.” Xu emphasized that the core of digital health lies in the collection and integration of real-world data, calling for greater collaboration among APEC economies to build an interconnected, inclusive, and sustainable digital health ecosystem. “Reliable and practice-based data is the lifeline of digital healthcare,” Xu stated. “True innovation begins with real-world practice — only through a solid data foundation can we achieve dynamic learning, precise adaptation, and continuous improvement.” Drawing from MEBO’s experience in regenerative medicine and wound care across the APEC region, Xu highlighted how MEBO’s training and technological transfer programs have strengthened local emergency response capabilities while laying the groundwork for digitalized clinical assessment and diagnosis. He underscored the global relevance of regenerative medical science pioneered by Professor Rongxiang Xu, which offers accessible and effective solutions for chronic wound management and inclusive healthcare development. Addressing the diversity of APEC economies, Xu called for balancing global standards with local adaptability, noting that AI and digital tools can enhance quality control while respecting regional conditions. He proposed three future directions for collaboration: integrating innovation with social responsibility, addressing health impacts of climate change, and building global humanitarian partnerships for joint action. Xu also introduced the “Silver Healing: Equitable Community Wound Care” initiative, jointly launched with the Clinton Global Initiative, aimed at delivering regenerative care and community-based health education to underserved aging populations worldwide. “As business innovation meets social value, and science connects with community needs, sustainable development becomes possible,” Xu concluded. His speech received wide attention from international media and reinforced MEBO Group’s leadership in advancing digital health cooperation across the Asia-Pacific. Over the past three years—from San Francisco to Lima, and now Gyeongju—Kevin Xu, as former Chair of the APEC Host Committee, has continuously contributed forward-looking insights and practical initiatives to Asia-Pacific economic cooperation and global health governance. Looking ahead, he aims to further extend bridges of collaboration through APEC and beyond, connecting diverse partners to build a more inclusive, resilient, and vibrant future for the Asia-Pacific and the world. desc: On June 1, 2026, the forum “Silicon Valley at APEC: AI, Infrastructure & Global Competitiveness” was successfully held at the University of Hong Kong campus.
headings: Silicon Valley at APEC: AI, Infrastructure & Global Competitiveness Forum Held in Hong Kong
text: Silicon Valley at APEC: AI, Infrastructure & Global Competitiveness Forum Held in Hong Kong | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/APEC Silicon Valley at APEC: AI, Infrastructure & Global Competitiveness Forum Held in Hong Kong June 2, 2026|Posted by: MEBO Group APECSILICON VALLEY SUMMITHONG KONG, CHINADIGITAL ECONOMY On June 1, 2026, the forum “Silicon Valley at APEC: AI, Infrastructure & Global Competitiveness” was successfully held at the University of Hong Kong campus. The event was jointly hosted by MEBO Group, the Bay Area Council, and the University of Chicago, bringing together leaders from government, industry, academia, and innovation ecosystems across the Asia-Pacific region. The forum was structured as a high-level policy and innovation dialogue platform focusing on artificial intelligence, digital infrastructure, workforce transformation, and cross-regional competitiveness. It featured keynote remarks, fireside discussions, and three thematic panels addressing AI and the future of work, AI infrastructure and energy systems, and AI-enabled sports and visitor economy innovation. APEC 2023 Host Committee Chairman and Executive Board Member of the Bay Area Council Kevin Xu delivered welcome remarks, emphasizing APEC’s role as a leading multilateral platform for regional economic cooperation and innovation-driven growth. He highlighted Hong Kong’s strategic position as a global bridge connecting Silicon Valley and the Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macao Greater Bay Area. The program also featured keynote and expert contributions from the Bay Area Council Economic Institute and senior representatives from leading global technology, policy, and academic institutions. Discussions explored AI’s impact on global labor markets, digital infrastructure expansion, energy demand for data-driven economies, and sustainable innovation frameworks. During the Fourth APEC Silicon Valley Summit Hong Kong Chapter, MEBO Group signed a strategic MOU with the NCAPEC Foundation to strengthen APEC-aligned cooperation across public communication, cross-regional dialogue, people-to-people exchange, and sustainable development. The summit was supported by the HKU Jockey Club Global Institute for Sustainable Development, Clinton Global Initiative, Kevin Xu Institute at the University of Chicago, Equitech Futures, and the Sacramento–China Office. MEBO Group reaffirmed its commitment to leveraging platforms such as APEC and CGI to advance regional collaboration and sustainable growth across the Asia-Pacific. title: MEBO Group Enhances Global Healthcare Through APEC 2024 Partnership in Peru
desc: On April 19, 2024, the MEBO Group marked a significant milestone in international healthcare collaboration by visiting ANIQUEM, a leading nonprofit organization in Lima, Peru.
headings: MEBO Group Enhances Global Healthcare Through APEC 2024 Partnership in Peru
text: MEBO Group Enhances Global Healthcare Through APEC 2024 Partnership in Peru | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/CSR MEBO Group Enhances Global Healthcare Through APEC 2024 Partnership in Peru April 22, 2024|Posted by: MEBO Group CSRPERUANIQUEMCHILDREN On April 19, 2024, the MEBO Group marked a significant milestone in international healthcare collaboration by visiting ANIQUEM, a leading nonprofit organization in Lima, Peru. This visit, aligned with the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) 2024 activities, underscores MEBO's commitment to leveraging its expertise in burn treatment and rehabilitation across the globe. Fostering Dialogue and Cooperation at APEC The initiative began with a pivotal dialogue at the APEC summit in November last year, where MEBO’s Chairman, Kevin Xu, engaged with Peruvian President Dina Boluarte. Their discussions focused on enhancing MEBO's role in the forthcoming APEC activities and its broader contributions to global health. This led to a fruitful partnership with the APEC Peru Organizing Committee (COMEXPERU), setting the stage for a series of healthcare-focused events in 2024. COMEXPERU has embraced this collaboration enthusiastically, organizing events that concentrate on advancing burn treatment protocols and rehabilitation techniques. MEBO’s engagement with local entities like ANIQUEM facilitates the exchange of critical medical knowledge and practices, enhancing the capabilities of both organizations in managing and preventing burn injuries. A Visit to ANIQUEM: Sharing Knowledge and Resources During their visit, MEBO’s Vice President Liu Gang and representatives from the International Department explored ways to deepen public welfare cooperation aligned with APEC themes and the Clinton Global Initiative. ANIQUEM, a self-sustaining NGO, has been at the forefront of providing rehabilitation services to the underprivileged, particularly young burn survivors, for over 25 years. In the last year alone, they have impacted the lives of 2,859 patients, with significant attention to children under five. The MEBO delegation was welcomed by Cecilia, the head of ANIQUEM, who provided an extensive overview of the organization’s evolution, current operations, and impact. The visitors toured the facility, observing various therapeutic and rehabilitative processes, including physical rehabilitation, psychological counseling, and specialized treatments like hydrotherapy and burn pressure mask therapies. Subsequent discussions highlighted MEBO’s ongoing commitment to pediatric care in Peru, sharing insights into the company's origins, growth, and significant achievements in public welfare. Both teams deliberated on practical steps for future collaborations, such as donations, medical training programs, and child care initiatives, aiming to formalize an action plan to accelerate these activities. A Commitment to Global Health and Community Support This visit not only broadened MEBO’s influence in the international healthcare arena but also reinforced its role as a mission-driven organization committed to significant contributions to global community health. Through continued partnerships and initiatives, MEBO remains dedicated to enhancing the quality of life and healthcare standards worldwide, embodying its core mission of service and innovation in medical practice. headings: MEBO Group Launches “Life Regeneration Action” to Aid Burned Children in Partnership with ANIQUEM at APEC 2024
text: MEBO Group Launches “Life Regeneration Action” to Aid Burned Children in Partnership with ANIQUEM at APEC 2024 | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/CSR MEBO Group Launches “Life Regeneration Action” to Aid Burned Children in Partnership with ANIQUEM at APEC 2024 October 16, 2024|Posted by: MEBO Group CSRPERUCHILDRENBURN CARE As APEC 2024 nears, MEBO Group reaffirms its dedication to APEC’s mission of collaboration, legacy, and shared values. For the second year, MEBO Group, led by Chairman Kevin Xu, is a strategic partner in APEC initiatives, actively advancing burn prevention and treatment within the Asia-Pacific region. On October 15, MEBO Group joined forces with ANIQUEM, a Peruvian nonprofit, to introduce the “Life Regeneration Action” program, an effort that underscores MEBO’s humanitarian commitment to Latin American burn survivors and expands APEC’s scope in child health and safety. Kevin Xu’s Leadership in Burn Care for APEC 2024 Chairman Xu first championed burn care as a key issue for APEC’s agenda in 2023, spurring actions that have fostered cross-border collaboration and resource-sharing aimed at improving burn care networks throughout APEC member economies. During his October 3 visit to Peru, Xu helped launch the Peru chapter of the “Life Regeneration Action” program, emphasizing the profound impact of burn treatment on families and communities. Xu expressed his hope for APEC to serve as a platform that promotes advanced burn treatment technologies, ultimately ensuring a healthier, safer environment for children. ANIQUEM and MEBO Group: A Partnership for Child Recovery ANIQUEM President Dr. Raúl Rodríguez Vilca lauded the partnership, highlighting the organization’s achievements in burn prevention and treatment. This alliance promises comprehensive recovery services, including physical and psychological therapies, for young survivors from impoverished backgrounds. MEBO Group Vice President Liu Gang formalized the collaboration by signing an agreement with ANIQUEM, ensuring that the program provides custom pressure garments, therapy, and burn prevention education to improve the lives of affected children and their families. Inspiring Hope and Resilience Among Burn Survivors The event also featured the “Little Mebo” panda toy, a gift from MEBO that resonated deeply with the children, symbolizing hope and friendship. The young attendees participated in an art session, expressing their dreams for the future with vibrant paintings. Among them, Valentina presented a colorful heart-shaped piece to Chairman Xu, a gesture of gratitude that added a heartfelt moment to the occasion. With the “Life Regeneration Action” program launch, MEBO Group leads the way in APEC 2024 initiatives, championing public welfare, industry innovation, and global healthcare collaboration, solidifying its commitment to corporate responsibility on an international scale. title: The 21st ISBI Congress: Vibrant Mexico, an Academic Feast, and a Journey of Original Aspiration
desc: At the first in-person ISBI Congress since the pandemic, held in Guadalajara, MEBO Group — longtime platinum sponsor — drew global attention with a butterfly-inspired booth and held cooperation talks with ISBI leadership and UC Davis.
headings: The 21st ISBI Congress: Vibrant Mexico, an Academic Feast, and a Journey of Original Aspiration
text: The 21st ISBI Congress: Vibrant Mexico, an Academic Feast, and a Journey of Original Aspiration | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/Global Programs The 21st ISBI Congress: Vibrant Mexico, an Academic Feast, and a Journey of Original Aspiration August 31, 2022|Posted by: MEBO Group GLOBAL PROGRAMSISBIBURN CAREMEXICO From August 28 to September 1, the 21st Congress of the International Society for Burn Injuries (ISBI) was held at the Guadalajara Convention Center in Mexico. Guadalajara, Mexico's second-largest city, drew burn experts from around the world to discuss the future of burn treatment — the first ISBI congress to return to in-person format since the pandemic, showcasing the latest global research results, clinical treatment experience, and innovative technologies. At the opening ceremony, ISBI Secretary-General Professor Ariel Miranda delivered remarks, noting that the past two years had been extraordinarily difficult for the world, yet all those devoted to the cause of burn care can overcome hard times together. ISBI President Dr. Greenhalgh emphasized that ISBI, as a leading international burn treatment organization, should promote global cooperation to comprehensively raise treatment standards — and gave heartfelt thanks to contributors, highlighting that the consistent support of pharmaceutical companies is an indispensable part of ISBI's progress. As the platinum sponsor of this and many previous congresses, MEBO Group has long been committed to growing with ISBI. MEBO Group Chairman Kevin Xu and Antonio Yung, Chief Representative of the Sacramento-China Office, attended the congress. At the booth, they held cordial talks with ISBI Secretary-General Dr. Ariel Miranda on possible future project cooperation in Mexico, and held further in-depth discussions with Professor Tina Palmieri of the UC Davis Medical Center burn surgery department on future academic collaboration. In the bustling exhibition hall, MEBO Group's creative booth stood out most: its clean form and graceful lines resembled a butterfly breaking from its cocoon — symbolizing regenerative medical technology bringing benefit to burn patients worldwide, freeing them from painful disease to emerge reborn. Attendees from around the world stopped to learn about MEBO's products, technology, and latest progress — including physicians already applying regenerative medical technology, and many newcomers eager to try it after witnessing its results. Mexican doctors who had achieved good results with MEBO Moist Exposed Burn Ointment visited the booth to discuss local registration, sales, and promotion in Mexico. ISBI President Dr. Greenhalgh also stopped by to try the ointment and thank MEBO Group for its sustained support of ISBI. As ISBI's long-term partner, MEBO Group looks forward to broader and deeper cooperation in writing a new chapter for burn treatment worldwide. text: 2023 International Diabetic Lower Extremity Symposium Held in Phuket, Thailand | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/Global Programs 2023 International Diabetic Lower Extremity Symposium Held in Phuket, Thailand October 25, 2023|Posted by: MEBO Group GLOBAL PROGRAMSDIABETIC FOOTTHAILANDSYMPOSIUM On October 25, 2023, the International Diabetic Lower Extremity Symposium (IDLES) made its Asian debut in Phuket, Thailand. Held by the International Society of Regenerative Medicine and Wound Repair (ISRMWR) in collaboration with the Rongxiang Xu, MD, Center for Regenerative Therapeutics at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (BIDMC) of Harvard Medical School, the symposium addresses the unmet needs of diabetic lower extremity management and explores the future of regenerative medical technology through global expert collaboration. The event was attended by more than 200 medical professionals from 17 countries, including the United States, the United Kingdom, Bulgaria, Greece, New Zealand, India, Ukraine, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and China. Dr. Aristidis Veves, Professor of Surgery at Harvard Medical School and Director of the Rongxiang Xu, MD, Center for Regenerative Therapeutics at BIDMC, delivered the opening speech, expressing hope that the symposium would catalyze new ideas among participants. Kevin Xu, President of ISRMWR and Co-Chair of the APEC 2023 Host Committee, emphasized that the symposium is not only a platform for academic exchange and knowledge sharing but also a unique opportunity to commemorate Professor Rongxiang Xu — and that achievements in regenerative medicine can be translated into greater impact at major international forums like APEC. Throughout the three-day symposium, medical professionals from around the world delivered talks on a diverse range of topics within the scope of the diabetic lower extremity. What makes the 2023 IDLES distinctive is its APEC session, where Dr. Tina Palmieri — Treasurer of the International Society for Burn Injuries and Past President of the American Burn Association — drew attention to the social and health problems caused by burns. Encouraging open-mindedness, she noted that regenerative medical technology, already supported by robust clinical evidence, holds great promise for the future. The 2023 IDLES was impactful in many ways: it not only illuminated new ways of treating the diabetic lower extremity but also generated ideas that could push the boundaries of regenerative medical technology. The prospects for medical research and cooperation among APEC economies have never been more promising. headings: 22nd ISBI Congress Convenes Successfully in Birmingham
text: 22nd ISBI Congress Convenes Successfully in Birmingham | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/Global Programs 22nd ISBI Congress Convenes Successfully in Birmingham August 22, 2024|Posted by: MEBO Group GLOBAL PROGRAMSISBIBURN CAREUNITED KINGDOM The 22nd Congress of the International Society for Burn Injuries (ISBI) took place in Birmingham, UK, from August 18-22, 2024, focusing on “Exchanging Knowledge to Improve Burn Care Around the World—Facing the Future.” Co-hosted by the British Burn Association, the event brought together over 1,000 burn care specialists from 47 countries to share insights and collaborate on improving global burn care practices. ISBI President-elect David Harrington opened the congress by emphasizing the historic submission of 880 abstracts, demonstrating ISBI’s expanding global impact. Current ISBI President Folke Sjoberg outlined upcoming initiatives, including the Global Audit Project. This program aims to standardize burn care practices in developing nations and will launch in eight countries over the next six years. MEBO Group’s Strategic Presence MEBO Group was prominent at the congress, showcasing its cutting-edge regenerative medical technology. The company’s innovative exhibition highlighted contributions to APEC, the Kevin Xu Initiative, and global training programs, attracting significant attention from medical professionals. Regenerative Medicine in Focus On the first day, MEBO Group hosted a seminar titled “Regenerative Medicine: The Future of Wound Management.” The seminar featured a range of speakers, including MEBO’s Director of Technology, Weiwei Xu, who introduced the company’s global project, “Mending Europe: Empowering the establishment of regeneration network,” which has established a regenerative medicine network across six European countries. Other notable presentations included cutting-edge treatments for facial burns and large-scale burn injuries. The second day featured a keynote by Gerald Abesamis, who highlighted the clinical benefits of MEBO’s Moist Exposed Burn Therapy (MEBT) for facial burns. His presentation showcased MEBT’s superior healing outcomes and pain relief compared to traditional treatments. The ISBI Congress remains one of the premier events in global burn care. MEBO Group’s contributions at the 2024 congress further solidified the role of regenerative medicine on the world stage. The next congress, scheduled for 2026 in Santiago, Chile, promises to continue this momentum. desc: The 35th European Wound Management Association (EWMA) Conference occurred from March 26 to 28 in Barcelona, gathering 6,000 experts from 90+ countries.
headings: The 35th European Wound Management Association (EWMA) Conference Held in Barcelona
text: The 35th European Wound Management Association (EWMA) Conference Held in Barcelona | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/Global Programs The 35th European Wound Management Association (EWMA) Conference Held in Barcelona March 28, 2025|Posted by: MEBO Group GLOBAL PROGRAMSEWMAWOUND CARESPAIN The 35th European Wound Management Association (EWMA) Conference occurred from March 26 to 28 in Barcelona, gathering 6,000 experts from 90+ countries. Under the theme "‘Moving towards excellence in wound management by breaking frontiers and silos," the event facilitated interdisciplinary collaboration and showcased cutting-edge advancements in wound management. Key Highlights EWMA President Kirsi Isoherranen opened the conference, emphasizing global academic initiatives in wound care. With 800+ keynote presentations, the event provided insights into groundbreaking research and clinical strategies. Nearly 200 pharmaceutical and medical technology companies participated. MEBO Group, an eight-time participant, highlighted its regenerative products, including MEBO Moist Exposed Burn Ointment and wound care patches, sparking discussions on their clinical applications. Regenerative Medicine Focus Beyond the exhibition, regenerative medicine emerged as a focal point of academic discussion throughout the conference. On the first afternoon, a dedicated symposium, "Reshaping Wound Healing: From Clinical Practice to Technological Innovation," took center stage. As a pivotal initiative under the Clinton Global Initiative (CGI) program "Mending Europe: Empowering the Establishment of Regeneration Network," the symposium explored innovative regenerative medicine applications in acute and chronic wound management. Life Regeneration Action Global Tour A significant highlight of the symposium was the European debut of the Life Regeneration Action Global Tour, an initiative launched in 2015. This program has since contributed significantly to advancing medical training, disaster response, burn treatment, and women's and children's healthcare, underscoring MEBO Group's commitment to improving global health outcomes. Looking Ahead As one of Europe's most influential academic platforms, EWMA continues to shape the future of wound management worldwide. The conference strengthened the role of regenerative medical technology in Europe and laid the groundwork for further global collaboration. The next EWMA Conference is set to take place in Bremen, Germany, in May 2026—an event eagerly anticipated by the international wound care community. Their presence signaled Brazil’s strong support for the forum’s mission. Founded in 2010, the BRICS Business Forum fosters dialogue among member nations, promotes trade, and drives practical cooperation in energy transition, digital technology, and economic policy. MEBO Group’s strategic role and Xu’s leadership underscore the company’s growing influence in shaping global economic governance through emerging market partnerships. title: MEBO Group Chairman Kevin Xu Announces New Global Health Initiative at CGI Health Working Group
desc: 'Silver Healing: Equitable Community Wound Care' will bring regenerative medical technology from clinical settings to community-level healthcare across 28 countries and regions from 2025 to 2028 — the latest milestone in a decade of MEBO-CGI partnership.
headings: MEBO Group Chairman Kevin Xu Announces New Global Health Initiative at CGI Health Working Group
text: MEBO Group Chairman Kevin Xu Announces New Global Health Initiative at CGI Health Working Group | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/Global Programs MEBO Group Chairman Kevin Xu Announces New Global Health Initiative at CGI Health Working Group September 24, 2025|Posted by: MEBO Group GLOBAL PROGRAMSCGISILVER HEALINGELDERLY CARE On September 24, 2025, Kevin Xu, Chairman of the Board of MEBO Group, was invited to the Clinton Global Initiative (CGI) Health Working Group meeting, where he officially launched a new global program — 'Silver Healing: Equitable Community Wound Care'. The initiative aims to extend regenerative medical technology from professional clinical settings to community-level healthcare, providing accessible and sustainable wound care solutions for elderly patients worldwide. The program is planned for implementation across 28 countries and regions within the Asia-Pacific, ASEAN, and the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) from 2025 to 2028, seeking to improve the quality of care for tens of thousands of elderly patients with chronic wounds through community wound therapist training, health education campaigns, and medical donations. This initiative marks another milestone in the decade-long partnership between MEBO Group and CGI. Since 2015, the two sides have jointly advanced regenerative medical technology worldwide through medical training, humanitarian aid, and youth leadership development — from large-scale doctor training in China to regenerative medical technology initiatives across Latin America and Europe, as well as youth innovation projects during the COVID-19 pandemic. Over the years, former U.S. President and CGI Founder Bill Clinton has repeatedly praised Kevin Xu and MEBO Group for their outstanding global contributions. This decade-long collaboration has not only accelerated the internationalization of regenerative medical technology but also embodied the integration of scientific innovation, talent cultivation, and humanitarian action — fulfilling the mission of 'Striving for Human Regenerative Life'. text: Global Experts Convene in Bali for the 2025 International Diabetic Lower Extremity Symposium | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/Global Programs Global Experts Convene in Bali for the 2025 International Diabetic Lower Extremity Symposium October 23, 2025|Posted by: MEBO Group GLOBAL PROGRAMSDIABETIC FOOTINDONESIASYMPOSIUM The 2025 International Diabetic Lower Extremity Symposium was successfully held from October 22 to 23 in Bali, Indonesia. Organized by the International Society of Regenerative Medicine and Wound Repair (ISRMWR) and co-hosted by the Indonesian Society of Surgeons and the National Rongxiang Xu Foundation in America, the conference gathered over 300 experts and scholars from more than 20 countries to explore breakthroughs in diabetic foot treatment and wound care innovation. Opening with a traditional Indonesian dance, the event featured remarks from Professor Aristidis Veves, Director of the Harvard Medical School Rongxiang Xu Center for Regenerative Therapeutics; Professor Heri Setyanto, President of the Indonesian Society of Surgeons; and Ms. Li Li, Chairwoman of the National Rongxiang Xu Foundation in America. The “APEC Dialogue” session, featuring experts from China, Indonesia, and New Zealand, highlighted each nation’s approaches to diabetic wound care and further strengthened regional cooperation under the APEC framework. The symposium also included country-focused sessions for Indonesia and China, introducing localized applications of regenerative medical technologies and sharing integrated approaches combining traditional and modern medicine. With its precise structure, in-depth dialogue, and rich academic content, the 2025 conference not only provided new insights for global diabetic foot care but also strengthened cross-economy medical cooperation through the APEC platform. The event attracted broad coverage from major international media outlets, highlighting its academic influence and global relevance. ISRMWR announced that it will continue to expand collaboration with APEC economies and international partners, advancing wound healing science and contributing to the sustainable development of global health. text: Regenerative Medical Technology Empowers Burn Care: MEBO Group Shines at the 2026 ABA Orlando Conference | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/Global Programs Regenerative Medical Technology Empowers Burn Care: MEBO Group Shines at the 2026 ABA Orlando Conference April 17, 2026|Posted by: MEBO Group GLOBAL PROGRAMSABABURN CAREUNITED STATES The 58th Annual Meeting of the American Burn Association (ABA) took place in Orlando from April 14 to 17, 2026. In the opening presentation, ABA President Jeffrey Carter emphasized that innovation, collaboration, and humanistic care are the key drivers advancing burn treatment — a vision closely aligned with MEBO Group's commitment to driving technological breakthroughs through regenerative medicine and improving patient outcomes. As a global leader in regenerative medicine, MEBO Group has attended the ABA Annual Meeting for many consecutive years. This year, the company once again systematically presented its full-process wound care solutions. desc: The International Society for Burn Injuries and the American Burn Association have joined the Clinton Global Initiative commitment launched by President Bill Clinton and MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu — with online training already delivered to more than 140 medical professionals from Bulgaria and Ukraine.
headings: ISBI and ABA Join 'Mending Europe: Empowering the Establishment of a Regeneration Network' Initiative
text: ISBI and ABA Join 'Mending Europe: Empowering the Establishment of a Regeneration Network' Initiative | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/Global Programs ISBI and ABA Join 'Mending Europe: Empowering the Establishment of a Regeneration Network' Initiative September 19, 2022|Posted by: MEBO Group GLOBAL PROGRAMSCGIEUROPEMEDICAL TRAINING The International Society for Burn Injuries (ISBI) and the American Burn Association (ABA) have joined the Clinton Global Initiative (CGI) commitment 'Mending Europe: Empowering the Establishment of a Regeneration Network', launched by former U.S. President Bill Clinton and Kevin Xu, Chairman of the Board of MEBO Group. ISBI and ABA will fulfill this initiative together with MEBO Group and the International Society of Regenerative Medicine and Wound Repair (ISRMWR), delivering a series of training courses on burn prevention for both medical professionals and the public. Previously, MEBO Group had provided regenerative medicine training to medical professionals across Asia, Africa, and Latin America. 'Mending Europe' aims to establish a regeneration network in Europe by providing medical training, medical supplies, and funding — helping local medical facilities and professionals master regenerative medicine techniques and gain the ability to deliver medical treatment during emergencies and disasters. Under this CGI commitment, MEBO Group and ISRMWR have already provided online regenerative medicine training to more than 140 medical professionals from Bulgaria and Ukraine. Going forward, ISBI and ABA will cooperate with MEBO Group to keep delivering more online and offline training across Europe. text: MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu Makes His First Official Visit to Panama | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/Medical MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu Makes His First Official Visit to Panama January 30, 2019|Posted by: MEBO Group MEDICALPANAMADIPLOMACYHUMANITARIAN On January 29, 2019, Kevin Xu, Chairman and President of MEBO Group, began his first official visit to Panama, consulting with senior Chinese and Panamanian officials on the international public-welfare programs MEBO undertakes in Panama and Latin America, as well as on investment, trade, and market development. On the first morning, accompanied by Ou Ruiqi, Chairman of Latin America Investment Advisory Group, Kevin Xu — together with International Market General Manager Liu Gang and Chairman's Assistant Tao Guoxin — met at the Ministry of Health with Minister Dr. Miguel Mayo and Presidential Medical Adviser Dr. Temístocles Díaz Strunz, both cabinet-level officials. Both offered warm support, and the Minister immediately called the National Burn Care Association to arrange a visit that same afternoon. After the ministry meeting, the delegation was invited to lunch with Chinese Ambassador to Panama Wei Qiang. Xu introduced MEBO Group's history, its UN and Belt and Road public-welfare programs, and its intentions for investment and trade in Latin America; the Ambassador offered candid advice drawn from his many years of work in the region. That afternoon, as arranged by the Minister of Health, the delegation visited Panama's National Burn Care Association to learn about the treatment and aftercare of pediatric burns in the country, and invited the association to join future 'Every Woman Every Child' activities in Panama — an invitation warmly accepted. The first day proved highly productive. In the following days, Kevin Xu would hold further meetings with other ministries, the free trade zone, hospitals, and pharmaceutical companies, laying a solid foundation for MEBO's international public-welfare programs and market expansion across Latin America. desc: At the Clinton Foundation's CGI gathering, Hillary Clinton announced MEBO Group's new training commitment for Latin America and the Caribbean — 'Regenerative Wave: MEBT Training in Latin America' — and presented Chairman Kevin Xu with the commitment certificate.
headings: Regenerative Wave: MEBO Group Launches a New Initiative for Latin America
text: Regenerative Wave: MEBO Group Launches a New Initiative for Latin America | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/Medical Regenerative Wave: MEBO Group Launches a New Initiative for Latin America June 5, 2019|Posted by: MEBO Group MEDICALCGILATIN AMERICAMEDICAL TRAINING On the morning of June 4, 2019 (U.S. Eastern Time), Kevin Xu, Chairman of MEBO Group, took the main stage at the Clinton Foundation's CGI gathering in the U.S. Virgin Islands to witness the official announcement of MEBO Group's new training commitment in Latin America and the Caribbean: 'Regenerative Wave — MEBT Training in Latin America'. The initiative is a broad technical training program on regenerative medical technology for burns and wounds, launched by MEBO Group in renewed partnership with the Clinton Foundation. Former U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Rodham Clinton introduced the new MEBO Group project in detail and presented Kevin Xu with the commitment certificate on stage. Under the commitment, MEBO Group will train 160 medical professionals in regenerative medical technology across Puerto Rico, Panama, Ecuador, Colombia, Costa Rica, the Dominican Republic, Chile, and Cuba, complemented by disaster preparedness and relief training. The earlier CGI commitment 'From Cities to Countryside: Regenerative Medical Technology Physician Training Program' had successfully trained 20,000 Chinese doctors — highly recognized by President Clinton and the Clinton Foundation — pioneering the global development of Chinese burn and wound regenerative technology. MEBO Group has long been committed to cultivating regenerative medical experts who combine Eastern and Western medicine, and broad technical training is a vital form of the technology's internationalization. As initiator Kevin Xu noted, an international public-welfare commitment of this kind is not a simple path from here to there — it leverages international platforms to create a multiplier base for the global development of Chinese medical technology, exploring a Chinese path for public health philanthropy. He expressed the hope that more enterprises and organizations will take this road, using Chinese medical technology to confront world health challenges together. title: MEBO Group Restarts the Regenerative Wave in Latin America
desc: Honoring its 2019 Clinton Global Initiative commitment, MEBO Group and partner Difare relaunched the Regenerative Wave training program in Ecuador — reaching 400 healthcare professionals, far beyond the original goal of 160.
headings: MEBO Group Restarts the Regenerative Wave in Latin America
text: MEBO Group Restarts the Regenerative Wave in Latin America | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/Medical MEBO Group Restarts the Regenerative Wave in Latin America September 12, 2022|Posted by: MEBO Group MEDICALCGIECUADORMEDICAL TRAINING In 2019, Kevin Xu, Chairman of MEBO Group, announced at the Clinton Foundation gathering that MEBO Group would join the Clinton Foundation in delivering regenerative medical technology training across Latin America — the 'Regenerative Wave — MEBT Training in Latin America' program. Delayed by the pandemic, the commitment was renewed in 2022: together with its Latin American partner Difare, MEBO Group officially restarted the Regenerative Wave in September, fulfilling the pledge to train 160 medical professionals in the region. The first session took place in Quito on September 6, with more than 50 local healthcare workers attending in person, connected live to a second venue in Cuenca with over 40 participants. The session was also streamed online, enabling 188 more professionals across Latin America to learn and interact in real time. The second session, held in Guayaquil on September 7, drew an even warmer response — local clinicians have applied regenerative medical technology longer and with a stronger foundation. A session planned for 80 attendees ultimately welcomed more than 100, forcing organizers to add seats on the spot. Participants came from public hospitals, private hospitals, and clinics, spanning burns, plastic surgery, endocrinology, gynecology, and pediatrics — evidence of the technology's broad local recognition. Local media followed the sessions closely with on-site interviews and coverage. The curriculum covered two themes: the global development of regenerative medical technology, and its current progress in Latin America. Xu Weiwei, Director of the Beijing Office of the International Society of Regenerative Medicine and Wound Repair, systematically presented the technology's history, patents, and mechanisms — providing a physiological moist environment, relieving pain, controlling inflammation, preventing infection, improving scars, liquefying necrotic tissue, and promoting in-situ skin regeneration — alongside recent global clinical research and complex case studies. Difare medical advisor Eduardo Pactong then explained the TIME principles of wound bed preparation and how regenerative medical technology addresses each step, emphasizing its outstanding safety profile and its importance for pregnant women, newborns, and children. He shared successful Latin American cases in burns, diabetic foot, and plastic surgery, and introduced mebo.education, the academic website for the latest global developments in the field. In a lively Q&A, the speakers fielded more than twenty questions — from effects on epithelial growth factor levels to combination with other therapies and standardized procedures. In 2019 we promised to train 160 Latin American healthcare workers; three years later, we have far exceeded that goal by training 400. MEBO Group will continue expanding training programs across Latin America, bringing relief and benefit to more patients. title: Business and Academic Exchange in Ecuador: MEBO Group Sets Sail Again in Latin America
desc: During a week-long visit to Quito and Guayaquil, MEBO Group and its partner Difare reviewed market strategy, exchanged the latest clinical data on scar ointment, and witnessed regenerative medical technology helping diabetic foot patients avoid amputation.
headings: Business and Academic Exchange in Ecuador: MEBO Group Sets Sail Again in Latin America
text: Business and Academic Exchange in Ecuador: MEBO Group Sets Sail Again in Latin America | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/Medical Business and Academic Exchange in Ecuador: MEBO Group Sets Sail Again in Latin America September 13, 2022|Posted by: MEBO Group MEDICALECUADORPARTNERSHIPCLINICAL VISIT From September 3 to 9, 2022, MEBO Group traveled to Quito and Guayaquil, Ecuador, for a week of business visits and academic exchange. Back in 2010, MEBO Group, together with long-term partner Gulf Pharmaceutical Industries (Julphar) and Ecuador's Difare Group, signed a strategic cooperation agreement. Over the following decade, MEBO Moist Exposed Burn Ointment (MEBO) and regenerative medical technology developed rapidly in Ecuador, with the ointment becoming the leading product in its category. The first stop was Difare's office center in Quito. Market development manager Jorge Duran analyzed how MEBO ointment could be developed more deeply under current policy; hospital channel manager Alex Frixone and product manager Katiuska Naranjo reviewed 2022 market share, sales, and competitive analysis; and medical director Dr. Iván Ludeña with medical advisor Dr. Eduardo Pactong presented the year's technical training activities for doctors, nurses, and pharmacists, plus next year's academic promotion plan. The two sides also preliminarily confirmed plans for a Regenerative Life Action under the UN 'Every Woman Every Child' China partnership network. On September 6, MEBO Group and Difare's OTC team held a business and academic meeting on scar ointment, where MEBO technical director Xu Weiwei shared the latest global clinical data. On September 7 in Guayaquil, the delegation met Christian Konanz, General Manager of Difare's Dyvenpro S.A., agreeing that introducing new products is key to brand maintenance, with an initial import plan drafted. The following day, the team visited the clinic of Dr. Isabel Atocha, who has years of experience applying regenerative medical technology in diabetic foot care. She presented four patient cases — three of whom had been told elsewhere that amputation was necessary. After switching to regenerative medical technology, their wounds are healing well and amputation was avoided. The delegation also visited local pharmacies and met experienced local physicians, including Dr. Carlos Marquez, President of the Ecuadorian Burn Association, and Dr. Fernando Quintana, Head of Burns at Luis Vernaza Hospital. The trip concluded at Difare's 23,615 m² logistics center — built in 2020 with Austrian automation systems, processing 60,000 orders and two million products daily — where staff instantly located MEBO products among thousands of brands. Though brief, the week in Ecuador was highly productive. MEBO Group and Difare took a major step forward together — and even in the farthest corners of Latin America, MEBO keeps moving toward new achievements. title: MEBO Group Continues to Promote Regional Medical Exchanges, Focusing on Silver Healing
desc: The second 2026 session of the Latin America Regenerative Medical Technology Seminar series focused on regenerative treatment of elderly wounds, aligning with the 'Silver Healing' initiative co-launched with the Clinton Foundation.
headings: MEBO Group Continues to Promote Regional Medical Exchanges, Focusing on Silver Healing
text: MEBO Group Continues to Promote Regional Medical Exchanges, Focusing on Silver Healing | MEBO Group Skip to main content Home Who We Are Regenerative Medicine Product Studies & Journals News Contact ES EN Contact Us Home/News/Medical MEBO Group Continues to Promote Regional Medical Exchanges, Focusing on Silver Healing April 18, 2026|Posted by: MEBO Group MEDICALSILVER HEALINGPERUELDERLY CARE In 2025, MEBO Group joined hands with its Peruvian partner Discontinental to successfully launch the Latin America Regenerative Medical Technology Seminar program, which received widespread acclaim. In 2026, MEBO Group is continuing the program with six seminars planned for the year — two of them closely aligned with the Silver Healing initiative jointly launched by MEBO Group and the Clinton Foundation. The second seminar was held on April 18, 2026, focusing on the application of regenerative medical technology in the treatment of elderly wounds. It aligns closely with MEBO Group's 'Silver Healing: Building an Equitable Community Care System for Chronic Wounds' initiative, integrating specialized technical training with grassroots community medical programs to support the accessibility of medical resources and health equity. The seminar specially invited Kenai Benítez Salgado, founder of Mexico's MediCalli primary care program, and Yu Ran, Head Nurse of the Wound Care Center at Nanyang Nanshi Hospital, to deliver special presentations — deeply integrating Silver Healing medical training with local community healthcare entrepreneurship projects and effectively enhancing the accessibility of primary care services. Aimed primarily at community healthcare workers from Peru's Padomi home care project, the seminar drew more than 80 in-person participants, plus online attendees from Argentina, Costa Rica, and other Latin American countries, to an enthusiastic response. The first two seminars have provided Latin American healthcare workers with new approaches to wound treatment and expanded the practical application of regenerative medical technology in community care. In the second half of the year, MEBO Group will organize four more seminars, steadily advancing the rooting and growth of regenerative medicine in Latin America — bringing lasting, positive change to public health in the region and around the world.
